webrender fidelity corpus — pinned 2026-09-19
ADR 0028 D2: no JavaScript, no CSS cascade. Author <style> and
<link rel=stylesheet> are skipped (StyleFor Skip). A page that needs a
cascade is a named non-goal, not a workaround.

IN (UA-table; the guest can fetch these bytes):

  example-org.html      https://example.org/
  cern-home.html        https://info.cern.ch/
  cern-theproject.html  http://info.cern.ch/hypertext/WWW/TheProject.html
  httpbin-html.html     https://httpbin.org/html
  httpbin-forms.html    https://httpbin.org/forms/post
  rfc20.html            https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc20.html
  iana-reserved.html    https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved

NON-GOALS (cascade and/or renderer-side JS — not worked around):

  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML
      Vector skin, infoboxes, 18 <style> blocks (798 KiB fetch).
  https://www.w3.org/
      Modern W3C homepage: class-based layout, 157 ".png" refs in the
      document, not a UA-table page.
  https://neverssl.com/
      Load-bearing CSS (header/notice) plus a JS redirect; noscript is
      skipped by the UA table, so the designed page is empty.
  https://www.w3.org/MarkUp/Wilbur/
      class="warning" colours are a cascade.
  https://news.ycombinator.com/
      Table layout is in-model, but the homepage mutates hourly and was
      not pinned as a golden.

SCRIPTED (authored in-repo 2026-11-02, M211d #3870 — the ADR 0039 v3
wire's corpus rows; hermetic fixtures, not fetched pages. Scripts run in
the QJS.BIN --dom-rpc worker, never the renderer; the live-web spec's
scripted legs drive each row in-guest):

  scripted-reads.html     doc.title / node.text / node.attr reads, one
                          missing id's null, console.log -> serial
  scripted-compute.html   computed content (fib(25)) written into an
                          empty node and read back over the wire
  scripted-form.html      field.setValue form fill plus a status write
  scripted-timer.html     setTimeout callback writes after the parked
                          timer.next drain answers
  scripted-refused.html   refused ops (query/fetch/setAttr/unknown) —
                          each caught name is written into the page, so
                          the refusal reaches the user, not a silent gap
  scripted-storm.html     console.log storm crosses script_budget_ops
  scripted-kill.html      a parked mid-op worker for the kill leg — the
                          page stays stable, only the worker dies
